stories.article_id: strike on ukraine humanitarian hub is feared to be among wars deadliest-1793721396000
stories.question: What happened in Ukraine?
stories.answer: A Russian strike hit a humanitarian hub in the Zaporizhzhia region, according to The New York Times. At least thirty-one people were killed. Hours later, the US said peace talks will resume.

stories.article_id: trump says us will stop providing aid to israel after yearend-1793718591000
stories.question: And in Israel?
stories.answer: President Trump says US aid to Israel will stop after the end of the year. He accused Democrats of using that aid as a talking point.

stories.answer: Türkiye and South Korea are expanding nuclear and defence ties. Their latest deal explores funding for nuclear projects, as Ankara weighs partners for its planned Sinop plant.

stories.article_id: the nuclear waste repository in finland designed to outlast modern civilisation-1793721600000
stories.question: And the story out of Finland?
stories.answer: Finland is about to switch on Onkalo, a nuclear waste store deep underground, built to last one hundred thousand years. New Scientist has the details.

_articles.id: eu to hold security talks ahead of russia meeting-1793720100000
_articles.title: EU to Hold Security Talks Ahead of Russia Meeting
_articles.body: The European Commission will host talks on Ukraine in Brussels on Nov. 4, ahead of US-mediated negotiations with Russia in Abu Dhabi on Nov. 10-11. Ukrainian, American, European, NATO, and World Bank representatives will attend. The discussions form part of a diplomatic push on security guarantees and reconstruction, with Kyiv seeking binding commitments to prevent another Russian invasion.
